medicines.name: Paracetamol
medicines.use: Reduces fever and relieves mild to moderate pain
medicines.side_effects: Rarely causes side effects at normal doses. Avoid alcohol.
medicines.simple_explanation: This medicine brings down your fever and reduces pain like headache or body ache.

medicines.name: Amoxicillin
medicines.side_effects: May cause nausea, diarrhea, or allergic reaction
medicines.simple_explanation: This is an antibiotic. It kills the bacteria causing your infection. Complete the full course even if you feel better.

medicines.name: Metformin
medicines.use: Controls blood sugar in Type 2 diabetes
medicines.side_effects: May cause stomach upset initially. Take with food.
medicines.simple_explanation: This medicine helps control your blood sugar levels. Take it with meals.
